title: Sieges of Oran and Mers El Kébir
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Sieges of Oran and Mers El Kébir", at revision 1370746826, opens: "The sieges of Oran and Mers El Kébir of 1563 is a major attempt by the regency of Algiers to retake the cities of Mers el-Kébir and Oran from the Spanish." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7510593, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1563 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
